verdict.rationale: LibreChat's docs explicitly show Ollama as a supported custom-endpoint provider and generic support for OpenAI-API-compatible endpoints (which llama.cpp, LM Studio, and vLLM all expose), so local-model operation is achievable via librechat.yaml custom endpoints and self-hosted deployment (Docker/npm/Helm). However, llama.cpp, LM Studio, and vLLM are never named directly in the docs pack, and older community commentary explicitly states LibreChat 'does not currently make any effort to support locally-hosted open source models' beyond a LiteLLM proxy workaround, showing this has been a real friction point historically. missing for 10: explicit named documentation/config examples for llama.cpp, LM Studio, and vLLM, and confirmation that a fully local no-cloud setup is a first-class supported path rather than a generic custom-endpoint workaround.
